items.title: NTAP Q2 Deep Dive: AI, Cloud, and Product Innovation Drive Market Outperformance
items.summary: Data storage company NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 29.9% year on year to $2.03 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($2.1 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 13.2% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.58 per share was 21.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: NetApp Expands AWS Transform Support to Accelerate Enterprise Storage Migrations
items.summary: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP is now supported by AWS Transform, allowing enterprises to migrate attached storage and database workloads directly to AWS through a more integrated cloud migration process. Key Investor TakeawaysNetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) and AWS have expanded their collaboration by adding Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP as a supported storage target within AWS Transform.
